text:
The **MGAP forest map 2021**, from Uruguay’s Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries, identifies 68.1 ha of the 2021 loss area as planted forest, with *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda* listed as species. Another 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest.

The map provides forest-type context; it does not establish what caused the loss.
